about: Iscover (L017) and Voltaren suppositories (L018) overlap on 19 and 20 May before daily Somac (L019) starts on 21 May.
Twice-daily Brilinta (L031) covers the intramuscular Toradol dose (L036) on 22 January without recorded gastro-protection.
During Iscover treatment (L017), only Voltaren skin gel (L018) is used before Somac (L020) covers the full oral Brufen course (L019).
